name: docs-connector
description: Pull a company's documents from a remote store — a Git repository by URL, or a Google Drive folder through the Drive API — into a local mirror and link it to a brain, so the engine's git_docs / google_drive sources can seed a Company Brain from it. The engine stays zero-network and read-only; this plugin is the separate surface that fetches. Developer preview.

network.why: Clones / fast-forwards a Git repository the user names (with the user's own SSH key or credential helper), and reads Google Drive through the Drive API v3 with a read-only scope and the user's OWN OAuth client. Files land in a local mirror outside the data folder; the Second Brain Link engine then reads that mirror with zero network calls and tiers every file with its local sensitivity scanner. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.
endpoints: the Git remote the user configures
